bullet: Load the same plugin twice (`F09.load-plugin-twice`), known bug.
script:
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$QID/load_plugin" --json '{"plugin_ref": "qa-f09-mkt-plugin@qa-f09-mkt"}' --expect 200 --save F09.load-plugin-twice/second-load
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$QID" --query include_skills=true --quiet \
  --check agent.agent_context.skills len-eq 2 --check agent.agent_context.skills contains qa-f09-mkt-plugin-skill --check hook_config.user_prompt_submit len-ge 1
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$QID" --quiet --check hook_config.user_prompt_submit len-eq 1 --save F09.load-plugin-twice/get  # bug
